Maya: Hi @Diego — attaching a condensed first-week sprint plan + practical 30/60/90 with acceptance criteria. Copy/paste into calendar invite.

Maya:
```
First-week sprint plan (calendar-friendly):
Day 0: 1Password, SSO/MFA, Slack/email, hardware check
Day 1: 15m welcome, team intros, product 45m, local dev setup with buddy
Day 2: Pair on onboarding-safe issue, infra access review, Security quickstart
Day 3: Observability + tracing 30m, small perf doc or metric task
Day 4: Ship first small PR, 1:1 recap + finalize 30/60/90

30/60/90 (runtime eng — measurable):
30d: env ready + 1 merged PR (AC: CI green, reviewer sign-off)
60d: own a component and ship improvement (AC: metric delta or alert reduction)
90d: lead rollout and be primary on rotation (AC: runbook updated, post-rollout review)
```

Diego: This is great. Can you add who-to-ask for GPU quotas and infra tickets?

Maya: Sure — eng-infra for GPU quotas (ticket prefix "onboard-"), IT Support for hardware, eng-sre for oncall questions. OnboardingBot will DM training reminders.

Noah: Laptop status shows "label created"  ETA? Also where do I find starter issues?

IT Support: Hi Noah — carrier pickup delayed ~24h, will update. Starter issues: https://git.redwood.ai/onboarding/labels/first-timers (pinned in #eng-runtime).

Iris (Buddy): I'll DM Noah a 30-min repo walkthrough and two safe PR suggestions.

OnboardingBot: Reminder scheduled: Complete Security Foundations by EOD day 3.

Diego: I scheduled weekly 1:1s for first 6 weeks and a 30-day retro. Posting a short intro in #general on Monday.

Noah: Thanks all  excited to start.
